info.name: Talk stickers
info.summary: Stickers and GIFs in Talk, also from the phone apps
info.description:
Send stickers and GIFs in Nextcloud Talk, from the browser, the desktop app and the Talk apps for Android and iOS.
- **About 8,400 stickers** in five open-licensed packs (Fluent Emoji 3D, Noto Emoji animated and still, OpenMoji, Twemoji), downloaded by your server after installation - **Your own stickers**: images in a shared folder, one pack per subfolder - **Stickers arrive as pictures**, animated ones moving, without link text - **/sticker party** or **/sticker 🎉** sends a sticker from any Talk client, phones included - **/gif happy dance** sends a GIF from GIPHY (with the GIPHY integration) - **A sticker page for phones**, to add to the home screen and share stickers to Talk
After installation a background job downloads the packs (about 550 MB to download and 420 MB on disk, up to a quarter of an hour; or run `occ talk_stickers:packs`). Stickers and GIFs are sent as pictures with Talk 25 or later.
info.author: Dawid Ciepiela
